have been registered at this GP practice since I was a baby — first under Dr Phiminster, then Dr Popat, and now under Dr Aride — and I can honestly say the standard of care has remained exceptional throughout the years.

There is something incredibly reassuring about a practice that has supported me through every stage of life. The continuity, the history they hold, and the genuine compassion shown over decades is rare and deeply valued.

Dr Aride’s care is truly second to none. She listens attentively, never rushes appointments, and treats you as a whole person rather than just a list of symptoms. Her clinical knowledge is outstanding, but it’s her empathy, patience, and thoroughness that really set her apart. I always leave feeling heard, reassured, and confident in the plan of action.

In more complex situations, she takes the time to explain options clearly, follows up appropriately, and ensures nothing is overlooked. That level of diligence makes such a difference, especially when navigating ongoing health concerns.

The reception and wider team also deserve recognition — professional, respectful, and always trying their best in what I know is an extremely pressured NHS environment.

After being with this practice my entire life, I can say with complete confidence that the care here is consistent, compassionate, and of the highest standard. I am incredibly grateful.

Thank you for decades of dedication.

—
